docs.summary: Async helpers for game code: moving between the main thread and worker threads, and waiting on frames and game time.
Whether the caller is on the main thread.

Cancelled when the session the calling code belongs to ends: play mode stopping, scripts reloading or the game quitting. On a worker that is the session that started the work, so a loop that watches it stops even if a new session has begun since. Pass it to long running work, which nothing else can stop.
Resumes on the main thread, at the next frame when coming from another thread. Never resumes if the session that started the work has ended by then.
Resumes on a thread pool thread. Continues right away when already off the main thread.

docs.summary: Checks `condition` on the main thread once per frame until it holds. Called on the main thread, it is also checked right away.
Queues work for the main thread without waiting for it. Dropped if the session that started the work ends first. Runs at once when no loop is running.

Runs work on the main thread and blocks until it finishes, rethrowing what it threw. Runs at once when called on the main thread or when no loop is running, and carries over a session ending, since the caller is waiting. Throws `OperationCanceledException` if the loop stops first. Never call it from a thread the main thread is waiting on.
